`ENG-001-WIW-19` shows the format working on sight: *"Went without any food"* on *made fast* is a
sense of a DIFFERENT PARSE — *fast* the noun, not *made fast* the verb phrase — which is exactly the

## R616 — The standing path cannot carry an approve-as-written, and the exposure list follows

**David's two questions, answered from the code rather than from the week's behaviour.**

**ONE: the write site.** The standing path that sets `hintAuthoredBy`/`hintAuthority` on an item is
`apply-all-unlanded.ts:177-185`, fed only by amendments the shared reader extracts. **It is NOT
reachable from a ruling that changes no text**: line 170 — `if (before === h.authored) { ALREADY;
continue; }` — skips the whole write, authorship included. The guard is right about idempotence and
wrong about rulings: **it conflates "nothing to write" with "nothing ruled".** An
approved-as-written verdict has travelled only through hand-written one-shots
(`apply-annie-27th-hints.ts:70`, verdict `APPROVED`), never through the standing path. **"Approved

## R618 — The non-ACTIVE entries carry nothing; the resolver's status filter is PROPOSED, not written

**Count first: `en-error-spot-false-positive` (REJECTED) and `en-vocab-secondary-sense` (RETIRED)
have ZERO carriers.** No option anywhere holds either tag, so no rejected or retired wording is
reachable by a child today and nothing takes an R498 flag. The hole in the resolver is real and
currently empty.

**THE DESIGN (no write until ruled):**

- **The resolver returns the library hint only from an ACTIVE entry.** A tag resolving to a
  non-ACTIVE entry serves as if the option were UNTAGGED — the child gets nothing rather than a
  wording a reviewer rejected. **The fallthrough is named: `undefined`, the same value an untagged
  option already produces**, chosen because it is the one state every caller already handles.
- **It cannot fall through silently.** The resolver's choice type grows a reason —
  `why: 'tag resolves to a RETIRED/REJECTED entry'` — so serving-nothing-by-status is
  distinguishable from serving-nothing-by-untagged in any transcript or log, and R601's fault (two
  states, one output) is not rebuilt into the fix.
- **The check with no input:** `check:non-active-carriers` — every option whose tag resolves
  non-ACTIVE. Its population CAN legitimately be empty (it is today), so it calls
  `declareMayBeEmpty` with the reason printed on every run, and asserts the SCREENED denominator
  (options with tags) non-empty — the R582 shape, so a broken query cannot read as a clean bank.

## R635 — A strike span is MINIMAL, and her amendment closes the doubled row

**HER RULING: a strike span is the least content whose removal breaks the claim, and the completion
of record is the single span.** The ground is the strike test's own logic: *"a span that covers the
whole case is a citation that cannot fail"* — strike eight lines spanning every vindication and you
have struck the episode, so the test can never show the claim unsupported. **The empty-population
rule arriving on citations**, her fourth instance of the class, caught at the first landing that
could have carried it: the readings artefact completed the vindication with ONE span (47–48) and its
excluded runner-up reasoned; the batch artefact completed the same claim with EIGHT lines including
the excluded one. The single span is of record; **the eight lines are corroboration, recorded under
that word, where they cannot be mistaken for the citation** — now a field on the flag itself.

**HER SECOND RULING: the reason field is a live claim; `sourceProse` is the archive.** Her faithful
conversion reproduced *"the rabbit is unhurt"* — a clause her own twenty-second had struck as an
inference written as observation. *"Reproducing a known-false clause in a field the standard treats
as a live assertion is not fidelity, it is re-publication."* Amended here: reason asserted equal to
her replaced string byte-for-byte, her authored clause written, the displaced text stamped.

**AND THE DOUBLED ROW IS CLOSED.** The legacy string — asserted byte-equal to the traced string
first; a third text would have refused — is displaced with the trace artefact (`28f3cea8…`) named as
its record: the conversion as amended is the flag of record, and the mangled write's evidence is
preserved whole where it can never serve. **Census: 47 [legacy STRING flags] + 8 [pre-standard
OBJECT flags] = 55 [whole], units on the face.** Both strikes confirmed on her lines — vindication
[47, 48], ends-safely [59, 60, 61] — and the lander's `None` litter in the lines arrays cleaned in
the same pass.

## R640 — Her tripwire rule, filed in the channel family (her words)

> **Redundant derived numbers are how a loss announces itself: a number that states what it counted
> can be recomputed, and a recomputation that disagrees locates the gap.**

third leg of the same channel discipline: R255 says what a sender cannot claim, R583 says how a
receiver confirms, **and this says how a document keeps testifying after both** — the drain file's
`16 + 7 = 23, derived at emit time rather than typed` survived the very staleness that killed the
typed version of the same sentence, and this return's ten-versus-eleven was settled by the same
rule the day after she stated it. **The idiom card stays DRAFT (verified this turn) until her
sign-off block crosses; the wiring ships nothing a child can tap before then.**
